title: Add LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver
description: Handles the notification's 'log dose' action tap. Mirrors BootReminderReceiver's exact goAsync()+Dispatchers.IO+AppDatabase.getDatabase pattern (no DI framework in this codebase). Logs using the medication's default dose and the current time -- there's no UI here to show a too-soon confirmation, so it always passes acknowledgeWarning = true (matches this app's existing stance that concurrent logging is an expected scenario, not a race to block, per TECH_DEBT.md). Whether this dose re-arms the next reminder is decided by DoseLogging.logDose's live-Settings fallback (notifyOnNextDoseOverride = null), not by anything carried in the notification's Intent, so it always reflects whatever the user's current Settings toggle is -- consistent with what a fresh AddDoseDialog would default to.
acceptance_criteria: onReceive reads doseLogId, profileId, medicationId (all via getIntExtra, default -1) and defaultDoseAmount (via getStringExtra) from the ExactAlarmScheduler EXTRA_* keys, and returns early if any are missing/invalid
Uses goAsync() + CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch { ... } finally { pendingResult.finish() }, exactly like BootReminderReceiver
Calls DoseLogging.logDose(...) with givenAtEpochMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), doseAmount = defaultDoseAmount, acknowledgeWarning = true, notifyOnNextDoseOverride = null
After logging, calls NotificationHelper.cancel(appContext, doseLogId) to dismiss the original reminder notification
exact_code:
package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.notifications

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.AppDatabase
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.DoseLogRepository
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.DoseLogging
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.MedicationRepository
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data.SettingsRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        val doseLogId = intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID, -1)
        val profileId = intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, -1)
        val medicationId = intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID, -1)
        val defaultDoseAmount = intent.getStringExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT)
        if (doseLogId == -1 || profileId == -1 || medicationId == -1 || defaultDoseAmount == null) return

        val pendingResult = goAsync()
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            try {
                val database = AppDatabase.getDatabase(appContext)
                DoseLogging.logDose(
                    context = appContext,
                    doseLogRepository = DoseLogRepository(database.doseLogDao()),
                    medicationRepository = MedicationRepository(database.medicationDao()),
                    settingsRepository = SettingsRepository(appContext),
                    profileId = profileId,
                    medicationId = medicationId,
                    givenAtEpochMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                    doseAmount = defaultDoseAmount,
                    acknowledgeWarning = true,
                    notifyOnNextDoseOverride = null,
                )
                NotificationHelper.cancel(appContext, doseLogId)
            } finally {
                pendingResult.finish()
            }
        }
    }
}
